title: PublishedLog
description: The AUTHORED record of which chapters the author has AUTHORIZED as published. Publishing is an irreversible, outward-facing transition; per ADR-009 (Human Authority Boundary) it may not be inferred by the system from the existence of a draft — it requires an explicit human authorization action. This log IS that action, made durable: the author (or a human-authorized tool) writes it by hand. Like the Serial Plan and Novel Brain it is an AUTHORED input, NOT a story fact (ADR-006) and NOT a recomputed projection; it lives under sources/published-log.yaml, never under registry/. The system READS it (the inventory projection folds it with the produced-draft index into a drafted/reviewed/published/ready funnel) and NEVER writes it. Its absence means nothing has been authorized as published yet; consumers degrade to published=0. The projection is ADVISORY and never gates (ADR-003).

published.description: The chapters a human has authorized as published, by their draft task_id. Presence here is the authorization; the system never adds an entry on its own (ADR-009).

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the chapter was published, if recorded.

channel.description: Where it was published (platform/site), if recorded.
